text.p: Tropical Storm Levi, with 40 mph winds, is near 20.5n/126.9e, moving north northeast at 10 mph away from the Philippines. This system will intensify over open water this period, not threatening land. Luzon, Philippines, will recover slowly from flooding caused by this system as it passed through the region as a tropical depression on Monday.

Tropical Depression 06W, with 30 mph winds, is near 11.6n/156.9e, moving northwest at 7 mph. This system will intensify slowly while tracking northwestward over open water. It is no threat to land but will become an increased risk to shipping.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
